name: Seer of Battle
summary: Seer of Battle; Once per short rest, add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.  Seer of Battle; Your d4 becomes a d6 for your Warlock Path feature.  Seer of Battle; Once per short rest, give one ally advantage on an attack, save, or check as a reaction.  Seer of Battle; Your reaction advantage may be used after the d20 is rolled but before the result is declared.
descriptionMarkdown:
Seer of Battle; Once per short rest, add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.

Seer of Battle; Your d4 becomes a d6 for your Warlock Path feature.

Seer of Battle; Once per short rest, give one ally advantage on an attack, save, or check as a reaction.

Seer of Battle; Your reaction advantage may be used after the d20 is rolled but before the result is declared.
